archetypes.name: summary-parser-compat
archetypes.rationale: Run-summary punctuation touches emitted output and stalled-summary recovery.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the implementation for run-summary parser compatibility, including stalled-summary recovery and legacy committed summaries. Check that new renderers emit colon or comma separators and no literal em dash reaches user-facing report output. Verify tests cover both implement and design summary paths. Cite each finding with file:line evidence. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
